author: SA Editor Yoel Minkoff
title: Looking to comply with new laws, Apple (NASDAQ: AAPL ) this
text:
Looking to comply with new laws, Apple (NASDAQ: AAPL ) this week will begin hosting Chinese users' iCloud accounts in a local data center, taking a step that alarms some privacy specialists: storing the encryption keys for those accounts in China.
"Once the keys are there, they can't necessarily pull out and take those keys because the server could be seized by the Chinese government," said Matthew Green, a professor of cryptography at Johns Hopkins University.
